---
title: "Office Hours"
editor: source
---

Please stop by to introduce yourself or ask some questions about the course! 

Office hours are a great place to work on your assignments with fellow students and seek the help of the course assistants whenever you get stuck.

Further, each Reed student is entitled to one hour of [individual tutoring](https://www.reed.edu/academic_support/individual_tutoring.html) per course per week. You can sign up for individual tutoring in [iris](https://iris.reed.edu/). 


Below is the schedule of office hours for the week. We will update this calendar in case office hours need to change times or locations.
